recipes.name: The Easiest Caprese Salad (3 Ingredients)
ingredients: 2 heirloom tomatoes, sliced into ¼-inch thick slices
1 lb (453g) fresh mozzarella, sliced ¼-inch thick slices
instructions: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella into the same width and layer them on a plate. Generously dress them with your basil oil and salt. Serve and enjoy.
